cases.name: switch off (the default): a load writes nothing and prints nothing
cases.cmd: p='{"hook_event_name": "InstructionsLoaded", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "file_path": "{{FIX}}/ws-file/CLAUDE.md", "memory_type": "Project", "load_reason": "session_start"}'; w={{FIX}}/off-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; log="$w/.claude/local/context.log"; out=$(printf '%s' "$p" | env -u HARNESS_CONTEXT_LOG ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/context-log.sh); rc=$?; [ -e "$log" ] && l=present || l=absent; printf 'rc=%s out=%s log=%s' "$rc" "${#out}" "$l"

cases.name: switch at 0: the same, inert
cases.cmd: p='{"hook_event_name": "InstructionsLoaded", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "file_path": "{{FIX}}/ws-file/CLAUDE.md", "memory_type": "Project", "load_reason": "session_start"}'; w={{FIX}}/zero-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; log="$w/.claude/local/context.log"; out=$(printf '%s' "$p" | env HARNESS_CONTEXT_LOG=0 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/context-log.sh); rc=$?; [ -e "$log" ] && l=present || l=absent; printf 'rc=%s out=%s log=%s' "$rc" "${#out}" "$l"

cases.name: switch on: one tab-separated line per load - reason, type, bytes, tokens, the path relative to the root, the session's 8 first characters, no agent on the main chain; nothing printed
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-file; rm -f "$w/.claude/local/context.log"; p='{"hook_event_name": "InstructionsLoaded", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "file_path": "{{FIX}}/ws-file/CLAUDE.md", "memory_type": "Project", "load_reason": "session_start"}'; out=$(printf '%s' "$p" | HARNESS_CONTEXT_LOG=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/context-log.sh); rc=$?; awk -F'\t' -v s="$(printf '%.8s' '{{SID}}')" -v rc="$rc" -v o="${#out}" '{ printf "rc=%s out=%s n=%d f=%d ts=%s reason=%s type=%s bytes=%s tokens=%s path=%s sid=%s agent=[%s]", rc, o, NR, NF, ($1 ~ /^[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]T/ ? "ok" : $1), $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, ($7 == s ? "ok" : $7), $8 }' "$w/.claude/local/context.log"

expect.stdout: rc=0 out=0 n=1 f=8 ts=ok reason=session_start type=Project bytes=38 tokens=9 path=CLAUDE.md sid=ok agent=[]

cases.name: a rule loaded for a subagent names the agent; a path outside the root stays absolute, and a file that is gone weighs 0
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/ws-agent-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; p='{"hook_event_name": "InstructionsLoaded", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "file_path": "{{FIX}}/ws-file/sub/.claude/rules/x.md", "memory_type": "Project", "load_reason": "path_glob_match", "agent_id": "agent-1234567890"}'; q='{"hook_event_name": "InstructionsLoaded", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "file_path": "/nonexistent/CLAUDE.md", "memory_type": "User", "load_reason": "session_start"}'; for x in "$p" "$q"; do printf '%s' "$x" | HARNESS_CONTEXT_LOG=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/context-log.sh; done; awk -F'\t' '{ printf "[%s %s %s %s %s] ", $2, $4, $6, $8, NF }' "$w/.claude/local/context.log"

cases.name: a tab or a line break in a field is folded: one load stays one line
cases.cmd: p='{"hook_event_name": "InstructionsLoaded", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "file_path": "/no/such\tdir/CLAU\nDE.md", "memory_type": "Pro\tject", "load_reason": "include"}'; w={{FIX}}/fold-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; log="$w/.claude/local/context.log"; out=$(printf '%s' "$p" | env HARNESS_CONTEXT_LOG=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/context-log.sh); rc=$?; awk -F'\t' '{ printf "n=%d f=%d type=%s path=%s", NR, NF, $3, $6 }' "$log"

expect.stdout: n=1 f=8 type=Pro ject path=/no/such dir/CLAU DE.md

cases.name: an empty, {} , non-JSON, non-object or file-less payload: exit 0, nothing printed, no log
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/bad-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w"; r=''; for p in '' '{}' 'not json' '[1,2]' '"text"' '{"hook_event_name":"InstructionsLoaded","load_reason":"session_start"}' '{"file_path":42}'; do out=$(printf '%s' "$p" | HARNESS_CONTEXT_LOG=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/context-log.sh); r="$r$?:${#out} "; done; [ -e "$w/.claude/local/context.log" ] && l=present || l=absent; printf '%slog=%s' "$r" "$l"

cases.name: the log stays bounded: past 256 KiB its oldest half goes, from a whole line, and the new load is the last line
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/bound-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$w/.claude/local"; awk 'BEGIN { for (i = 0; i < 4000; i++) printf "2026-01-01T00:00:00+0000\tsession_start\tProject\t40\t10\t/old/file-%05d.md\told\t\n", i }' > "$w/.claude/local/context.log"; before=$(wc -c < "$w/.claude/local/context.log"); p='{"hook_event_name": "InstructionsLoaded", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "file_path": "{{FIX}}/ws-file/CLAUDE.md", "memory_type": "Project", "load_reason": "compact"}'; printf '%s' "$p" | HARNESS_CONTEXT_LOG=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/context-log.sh; after=$(wc -c < "$w/.claude/local/context.log"); first=$(head -n 1 "$w/.claude/local/context.log" | cut -c1-4); last=$(tail -n 1 "$w/.claude/local/context.log" | cut -f2,6); [ "$before" -gt 262144 ] && [ "$after" -le 131072 ] && b=ok || b="$before/$after"; printf 'bound=%s first=%s last=%s' "$b" "$first" "$last"

cases.name: a log that is a symbolic link is not written through, nor a folder in its place
cases.cmd: w={{FIX}}/link-{{SID}}; v={{FIX}}/link-{{SID}}-victim; mkdir -p "$w/.claude/local" "$v"; printf 'keep\n' > "$v/target"; ln -s "$v/target" "$w/.claude/local/context.log"; p='{"hook_event_name": "InstructionsLoaded", "session_id": "{{SID}}", "file_path": "{{FIX}}/ws-file/CLAUDE.md", "memory_type": "Project", "load_reason": "session_start"}'; out=$(printf '%s' "$p" | HARNESS_CONTEXT_LOG=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$w" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/context-log.sh); rc=$?; u={{FIX}}/dir-{{SID}}; mkdir -p "$u/.claude/local/context.log"; printf '%s' "$p" | HARNESS_CONTEXT_LOG=1 ORKEON_WORKSHOP="$u" bash {{CLAUDE}}/hooks/context-log.sh; rc2=$?; printf 'rc=%s/%s out=%s target=%s dir=%s' "$rc" "$rc2" "${#out}" "$(cat "$v/target")" "$(ls -A "$u/.claude/local/context.log" | wc -l)"
